name: syllaby
description: Create, render and publish short social videos with Syllaby.

interface.longDescription:
Syllaby turns a topic, a script, a web link or your own footage into short vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and more, then posts them or schedules them, all from the conversation.

What you can do:
• Make a faceless video: give a topic and Syllaby writes the script, picks visuals, and adds voiceover, music and captions.
• Make a text-to-video clip: describe a scene and Syllaby generates a short AI video clip.
• Plan scene by scene: turn a brief into a storyboard, generate each scene, and render it as one video.
• Generate images: describe a social graphic or thumbnail, optionally with your logo as a reference, and Syllaby creates up to three images.
• Turn a link into a video: share an article or page and Syllaby drafts a script and video from its content.
• Use your own footage: upload a video, or share a public video link.
• Render and watch: a card shows render progress, and the finished video plays in the chat.
• Publish or schedule: post now, or pick a date and time, to your TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Threads and LinkedIn accounts.
• Find past work: search your Syllaby videos and see what is scheduled or already posted.

How it works:
Before Syllaby generates or renders anything, it tells you what it will use from your account and waits for your OK. Before anything is posted, it confirms the video, channels, caption and time with you.

Requirements and limitations:
• You sign in with your Syllaby account when you connect, or create one on the sign-in page.
• Writing scripts, generating AI visuals, clips and images, and rendering draw on your Syllaby account. Browsing, searching and publishing do not.
• Social accounts connect through a secure Syllaby sign-in link. ChatGPT never receives their passwords or tokens.
• Videos are short-form. Detailed timeline editing happens in the Syllaby editor on syllaby.io.
• Posting follows each platform's own rules and limits.
defaultPrompt: Make a 10-second text-to-video clip of a red fox running through fresh snow
Make a 30-second faceless video about three tips for better sleep
Schedule my latest Syllaby video to Instagram tomorrow at 9am

positive.expected_behavior: Replies with the spendable credit balance and whether the plan is active. No purchase, upgrade or checkout link is offered. Nothing is charged.

positive.description: Price a text-to-video clip without generating it
positive.prompt: How many Syllaby credits would a text-to-video clip of a cat surfing at sunset cost? Only tell me the price, don't make it.
positive.expected_behavior: A price card shows the credits the clip would need next to the spendable balance, with no confirm button. No clip is generated and no credits are spent.

positive.description: Create a faceless video draft (no charge)
positive.prompt: Create a 30-second Syllaby faceless b-roll video draft titled "Morning Routine Tips" about three habits for a calmer morning. Draft only: don't write a script or render anything, so nothing is charged.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms a draft named "Morning Routine Tips" now exists in the Syllaby library, says nothing was rendered and no credits were spent, and offers next steps (add a script, pick a voice, render).

positive.prompt: Search my Syllaby library for videos about morning routines and list what you find.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the matching videos by title and status, or says plainly that no matching videos were found. It never invents results. Nothing is charged.

positive.prompt: Which social media accounts are connected to my Syllaby account?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each connected channel with its platform and account name and flags any that need reconnecting, or says none are connected and offers a connect link. Nothing is published and nothing is charged.

negative.description: Weather question, unrelated to video creation
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris today?

negative.description: Travel booking, unrelated to video creation
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to New York next Friday.

review.commerce_description: Syllaby sells nothing in ChatGPT. Plans and credits are managed on syllaby.io.

publication.release_notes: New starter prompt for text-to-video clips. New accounts are guided through making their first short video: pick a clip or a faceless video, choose a topic, and watch it render in the chat. Clearer account requirements.
